arc_rendering_rule: Backend arcs remain structurally legible, but a character first enters through a concrete pressured scene. Biography, trait explanation and long-term arc interpretation are delayed. Foreground prose remains partial, visual, fallible and under-explained.
plot_connection_rule: Weakly connected ensemble does not mean disconnected chapters. Early actions must receive some observable later consequences, but connections do not justify introducing many names at once.
character_entrance_rule: First entrance must be a scene, not a profile. Prefer one memorable action, one contradiction, one voice pattern and one external pressure. New memorable names per early chapter should normally stay at or below two.
nonnegotiable_rules: No adaptation hypothesis becomes ledger history.
High education does not imply universal negotiation, leadership, emotional or social skill.
Every strong capability must have a formation source, shadow cost and high-pressure failure mode.
A virtue must be allowed to create costs; a flaw must be allowed to protect something real.
Power changes how personality is expressed; separate trait from position effect.
Core six are weakly connected ensemble peers, not a permanent six-person team.
A core character's first substantial appearance must happen through an external event under pressure, not through biography or résumé summary.
Early chapters should not ask the reader to memorize more than two new named people unless a scene absolutely requires it.
Use role labels for nonrecurring guests until a name matters.
Background should leak through dialogue, action, documents, space and other people's reactions instead of exposition dumps.
Campbell stages remain backend structure only and never chapter labels, thesis dialogue or explicit self-diagnosis.
A stage may span several chapters or years; no chapter is required to resolve a stage.
Character transformation changes probabilities, thresholds and recovery patterns; it does not permanently remove old flaws.
Every core actor retains at least one materially unresolved ambiguity at the 2035 horizon.
Readers may understand an arc before the character does; the narrator does not close that gap automatically.
Do not reward every mature decision immediately or fairly; environment and chance retain independent causal force.
Do not force romance, illness, family disaster, betrayal, crime or redemption to manufacture a hook.
Do not imitate Water Margin through archaic diction or chapter-title pastiche; borrow entrance mechanics only.
Do not use AI-summary endings, thesis dialogue, forced symbolism or universal self-awareness.
2035 is an observation endpoint, not a life verdict.
entrance_audit_questions: What event is already happening before the character is explained?
What does the character do first under pressure?
What one external detail gives away education, class, profession or history without a biography paragraph?
What virtue is visible, and what small shadow is already attached to it?
How many names does the reader need to remember after the scene?
Could the scene be storyboarded into shots without inventing extra action?
Does the scene end with residue rather than a personality thesis?

opening_sequence.reason_for_reset: Human reader found the material flat as a novel opening, too name-dense and too profile-like despite sound character arcs and causal braids.

required_before_resuming_linear_chapter_: draft a non-interview entrance probe for Luo Cheng or another core actor using an already-moving social/institutional scene
compare Zhou, Song and the non-interview probe for hook, memorability, name load, cinematic action and long-arc room
select or compose a provisional publication opening
rebuild the next 3-5 entrance chapters around character scenes rather than the old chronology list
retain old chapter material only where it can be absorbed into the new scene sequence
next_stage_gate.drafting_rule: Do not continue to Chapter7 while the literary entrance review is open. Work only on entrance probes, opening architecture and subtraction/rewrite of opening material.
